conviction_note: Near-zero on both measurements. The release adds the first 2027/8 DPU forecast, which has to absorb Kobe Steel leaving ON Building on 2027-03-31 (about 100-170 yen a unit of mechanical drag before any reserve draw). Against that sit 1,184 yen a unit of internal reserve that the REIT has used twice before to support DPU through a vacancy, and a habit of beating its own DPU forecast. Findings sum to -0.05; the scaled number is (2x48/100-1)x1.3 = -0.05. The sign is close to a coin flip, so the scaled number is small even though abs_move_pct is above the 0.82 proxy.

The 2026-09-30 ON Building notice confirms neither was revised. findings.finding: This release carries the first 2027/8 (第51期) forecast, which includes Kobe Steel's exit from ON Building on 2027-03-31: the whole building, 4.1% of NLA, NOI about 1.24bn yen a year (3.1% on 39.9bn). The new tenant takes only 37% of the floor area from 2027-04-01, and the rest of its 68.3% phases in from 2027-10 to 2028-04. That leaves roughly 100-170 yen a unit of mechanical DPU drag against 1,795, unless the REIT draws on 4,216m yen (1,184 yen a unit) of internal reserve. It has done exactly that before: Kioicho in 2015 and Shiodome in 2021.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This line is introduced at the October prints, when a new August-period forecast first appears. Those prints moved -0.59% (2022-10-19), -1.49% (2023-10-19), -2.88% (2024-10-23, the first print after Kobe Steel announced its move) and -0.63% (2025-10-23), next close against release-day close (Yahoo daily bars). The April 2026 print, which carried new leasing news (the Sunroute contract) and a 13.4% rise in NAV, moved +3.68%.
findings.why_not_priced: The exit date and the new lease are public, but the DPU arithmetic for 2027/8 and whether reserves will cover it are not, because no period has been guided past 2027/2. If the drag were fully priced, the yield would already sit well above the J-REIT average. At 67,300 against a 3,628 yen annual DPU it yields 5.4%, at 0.74x NAV, which looks like a partial discount, not a full one.
findings.independence: Reserve size and precedent from the 2026-04-22 investor presentation (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260422/140120260422508149.pdf, pp. 14 and 49). The vacancy timing is in the 2026-03-31 cancellation notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260331/140120260331594518.pdf). Same issuer, different documents.

findings.finding: The 2026/8 actual DPU will most likely land modestly above the 1,814 yen forecast. The REIT beat its latest forecast in each recent period (2025/8 1,854 against a 1,766 initial; 2026/2 1,837 against 1,791 revised). The hotel variable rents for this period are set on base months of Nov 2025 to May 2026, when Japan Hotel REIT reported H1 2026 RevPAR up 4.9%, against MTR's 100% YoY assumption. No 予想修正 was filed, so the result is within ±5%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025/8 beat the forecast by about 5% and the stock moved -0.63% on 2025-10-24. 2026/2 beat by about 2.6% and it moved +3.68%, but that print carried other news. A beat on its own has not reliably been paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the beat habit is in the company's own chart and the hotel base months are history. It is kept small because the exact DPU is not public until 15:30.
findings.independence: Japan Hotel REIT H1 2026 RevPAR +4.9% (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/89850/140120260724599345.pdf, snippet_only)

findings.finding: The 2027/2 forecast of 1,795 yen faces mixed inputs. Its hotel base months are May to Nov 2026, and inbound arrivals fell 9.6% YoY in August 2026 on the China slump, against a company assumption of 101% hotel rent. The BOJ raised rates to 1.00% in June 2026, in line with the company's assumed 1.02% average funding cost. Office rent increases are running ahead of plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the last two prints the forecast for the next-but-one period moved by 5 yen or less (2026/8: 1,809 raised to 1,814). Small revisions have not been what moves this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the inbound and rate data are public. This is a macro-to-company proxy, so it is kept small.

findings.finding: The 9/30 notice says the REIT is still negotiating with several candidates for the remaining 31.7% of ON Building. A further signed lease could ride in the results package, as the Sunroute Plaza Shinjuku contract and the NAV jump did in April 2026, and the stock rose 3.68% that day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-22: new lease terms disclosed with the results and the stock moved +3.68% (the J-REIT ETF moved -0.17%).
findings.why_not_priced: Whether or when a second lease is signed is unknown. The expected value is small and the upside tail is real.
findings.independence: Leasing listings show ON Building floors marketed with April 2027 availability, last checked 2026-10-08 (https://officee.jp/catalog/20596)

outside_window.finding: Sunroute Plaza Shinjuku's new contract, with a higher fixed rent plus a variable rent, starts in September 2027, inside the 2028/2 period. That is beyond the two periods this release guides.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: 2027/2 DPU of 1,795 may move by a few yen. Returns: no buyback history and LTV 46.8%, so not expected. New-period guide: the first 2027/8 DPU, carrying the ON Building vacancy, is the main item. Quarter: the 2026/8 actual against 1,814, with a history of beats of 2.5-5%.
baseline_tension: The evidence neither agrees with nor cuts against the lean (-0.10) or the run-up (-5.2%). The run-up is the J-REIT index, not this name. The strongest positive the release could carry is a 2027/8 DPU held near 1,800 with reserves, plus another ON lease and a higher NAV. I looked for each and none is knowable before 15:30.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series): the ON Building drag and the negative October-print pattern are public, so p_up moved from 46 to 48 and the scaled number from -0.10 to -0.05. Finding sizes were left unchanged.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension. Findings were already balanced two positive and two negative, so nothing else changed.
